lines.zh: 我浮在末地的紫色虚空上。
lines.en: I float above the End's violet void.

lines.zh: 我的裙裾扫过浮岛边缘。
lines.en: My robes sweep the edges of the floating islands.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，空气都在发亮。
lines.en: The air glows where I pass.

lines.zh: 我不需要落地，光托着我。
lines.en: I need no ground; light carries me.
My mask reflects the end stone.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，碎石就浮起来。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the rubble rises.
I glide slowly over the waste.
I pass a city of the End.
Each step leaves a ring of light.

lines.zh: 我向下看，深渊在下面张着。
lines.en: I look down; the abyss gapes below.

lines.zh: 我让光在脚边慢慢收拢。
lines.en: I let the light gather slowly at my feet.
There is no expression beneath my mask.
End wind passes through me.
I'm measuring this island's height.
Light turns slowly around me.

lines.zh: 我不着急，时间对我没有意义。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry. Time means little to me.

lines.zh: 我的手指轻轻动了一下。
lines.en: My fingers move slightly.

lines.zh: 我听见低处有东西在爬。
lines.en: I hear something crawling below.
This city has long been empty.
I tilt my head to one side.

lines.zh: 我这具身体只是光的容器。
lines.en: This body is only a vessel for light.
I wait like a monument.
Endermen watch me from afar.
The light dims, then brightens.
I raise a hand and let it hang.
The sky here is black.
You've trespassed on my waste.

lines.zh: 我低头，看着你这个渺小的东西。
lines.en: I look down at you, a small thing.
My mask faces you.
There's no Argent light on you.

lines.zh: 你能走到这里，说明有点本事。
lines.en: Reaching this far means you have some skill.

lines.zh: 我面具下没有眼，你却知道。
lines.en: No eyes under the mask, and yet you know.
Your breathing is loud here.
I extend three fingers.
You take a step back. Noted.
This island is not yours.
I lift my chin slowly.
Will you stay, or turn back?

lines.zh: 我胸口的亚金乱了一下。
lines.en: The Argent jars inside my chest.
A crack appears in my mask.
I drift back half a step.

lines.zh: 亚金在我体内乱了一下。
lines.en: The Argent in me surges wrong.
I don't cry out. I go silent.
The edge of my robes frays.
I adjust my stance.

lines.zh: 我的裙裾被撕开一道口。
lines.en: A tear opens in my robes.
You can touch the light.
I raise my head and look at you again.
You think offerings matter?

lines.zh: 亚金的能量，你带得来吗？
lines.en: Can you bring Argent energy?
I don't eat what mortals eat.

lines.zh: 你这点东西，连光都点不亮。
lines.en: That wouldn't even light a spark.
You hold it up. I do not raise my eyes.
Set it down, then kneel.
Accepting it means nothing.
Your hand is shaking. I can see.

lines.zh: 这点火苗照不亮我的殿。
lines.en: That spark will not light my hall.
Take it away. Don't waste my time.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的光，被弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my aura and bounce off.
Not even my hem moves.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我裙边擦出声。
lines.en: Your armor scrapes along my hem.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你伤到了自己吧？
lines.en: That bump hurt you, didn't it?
The light lifts me a little higher.
I raise a hand and you retreat.
You shouldn't have touched me.
I hover there without reaction.
That contact was rude.

lines.zh: 再靠近，就不只是弹开了。
lines.en: Closer than that, and it won't just bounce.
Maykrs don't breed; they make.

lines.zh: 这座城是我留下的空壳。
lines.en: This city is an empty shell I left.

lines.zh: 我的同类早已不在此处。
lines.en: My kind are long gone from here.
I keep this waste alone.
Nothing answers my light.
I return my hand to my side.

lines.zh: 我数过这座空城所有的门。
lines.en: I have counted every door in this empty city.
This place will stay empty.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看向远处的岛。
lines.en: I look toward a distant island.
No sound there either.
I raise a hand and it rises.
Light wraps around it.
I pinch it between two fingers.

lines.zh: 这东西有一点亚金的余温。
lines.en: This carries a trace of Argent warmth.
I look, then set it down.
It drifts into my palm.
I draw it into my light.
Mortal iron is of little use.
I let it fall.
I keep one of these shards.
You've stood on my island long enough.
My light gathers.
Of the three powers, I take lightning first.
You've been enclosed.
My mask lights up.
I raise a hand, fingers pointing down.
I've closed one of your routes.
The Argent flows.
This blow needs no aiming.
You'd better not stop.
I begin the judgment.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我不需要知道。
lines.en: I don't need your name.
Light has filled this place.
I fix on your heart.
Don't look up.
Here it comes.
This island will remember you.

lines.zh: 我把三重光叠在你头顶。
lines.en: Three lights have stacked above your head.
You run; the light follows.
I can strike you without moving.
Lightning falls and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 你躲到石柱后，石柱碎了。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; it shatters.
My light is closing in.
Each lap you slow a little.
Ice crawls across the ground.
Your boots slip.
Fire rises from the cracks.

lines.zh: 三系轮转，你挡不住全部。
lines.en: Three powers cycle; you can't block them all.
I raise a hand and you look up.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我的冰厚一分。
lines.en: Each step you give, the ice grows.

lines.zh: 你每一步都踩进我的光里。
lines.en: Every step you take lands in my light.
You've backed to the island's edge.
The void is below.
Is there any other way?
I'll let you choose.
Then it ends.
The light grows brighter.

lines.zh: 你已经在我的掌心里了。
lines.en: You're already in my palm.

lines.zh: 我一掌挥下，光刃切开空气。
lines.en: My palm falls and a blade of light cuts the air.
The light hurls you into a pillar.
Ice shoots from my fingertips.
Lightning chases along the ground.
Fire bursts at your feet.
That blow was Argent.
I have no wrath, only judgment.
Light works its way into the crack.
You can still stand. Worth seeing.

lines.zh: 我的光刃把石柱切成两截。
lines.en: The light blade passes; the pillar parts.
The next will be heavier.
You're starting to glow.
That's not a good sign.
Ice falls from my palm.
In my light, you stand out.
I've seen your ending.

lines.zh: 我从末地的高处降下来。
lines.en: I descend from high above the End.

lines.zh: 我在浮岛边缘先起了光晕。
lines.en: A halo rises first at the isle's edge.

lines.zh: 荒原上的末影人散开了。
lines.en: The endermen on the waste scatter.

lines.zh: 我的裙裾落在一座浮岛上。
lines.en: My robes settle on a floating island.
This was once my hall.
Now only stone remains.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，废墟亮了一下。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the ruins glow once.

lines.zh: 亚金在我体内缓慢流动。
lines.en: Argent moves slowly inside me.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有动静。
lines.en: I hear something far away.
Something living has come in.
I won't hurry. I'll let it come.

lines.zh: 我的面具映着紫色的天。
lines.en: My mask reflects the violet sky.

lines.zh: 这座岛终于又有客人了。
lines.en: This island has a guest at last.
I don't intend to let it leave.
The light spreads slowly.
I stand, taller than the towers.

lines.zh: 我把末地的紫色点亮了。
lines.en: The End's violet slowly brightens.
Name yourself, newcomer.
Or don't.
It ends either way.

lines.zh: 火在我裙上燃起，又慢慢熄灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my robes and slowly dies.
I fall; the light can't hold me.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，但我感到窒息。
lines.en: There's no water here, yet I suffocate.
The blast tears my veil of light.
A round passes through my shoulder.
Our lights collide.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我会枯竭。
lines.en: I don't eat, but I can run dry.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的光乱跳。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my light scatters.
The void swallows my light.
